test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Copying someone else’s work and trying to submit it as your own
solution:
The correct answer is: **Plagiarism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Plagiarism"** means the practice of taking someone else's work or ideas and passing them off as one's own. (साहित्यिक चोरी)

 
 
• **Example:** The student was expelled for plagiarism after submitting a copied essay.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Plagiarism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Polygamy** (बहुविवाह): The practice of having more than one spouse at the same time.

 
 
• **Example:** Polygamy is still practiced in some cultures.
 
 
 
• **Preamble** (प्रस्तावना): A preliminary statement, especially the introduction to a formal document that explains its purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** The preamble of the Constitution outlines the fundamental purposes and guiding principles of the document.
 
 
 
• **Extempore** (तात्कालिक): Spoken or done without preparation.
 
 
• **Example:** She gave an extempore speech that impressed everyone.
